_comment: PLC5 (Pluspetrol S.A. Clase 5), verified October 2026. Every field is {value, source}. Required: issue_date, maturity, rate_type, rate (fixed) or base_rate + margin (floating), day_count (30/360, 30E/360, ACT/365, ACT/360, ACT/ACT), frequency_months, payment_dates or first_payment_date, amortization (pct of original face value, adding up to 100), business_day_rule (following, modified_following, preceding, none), business_day_calendars (AR, US). Optional: accrue_to_adjusted_date (default false: interest accrues to the scheduled date), interest_start_date, min_denomination, increment, last_payment_notice {date, interest_per_100, amortization_per_100, rate for floating}, call_schedule [{from, to (exclusive, optional), price_pct of outstanding principal}] for fixed-price call windows (make-whole periods are not modeled). Amortization tables rounded by the issuer may add up to 100 +/- 0.01; the last installment takes the remainder. Floating base_rate value: {name, rate, date}.

isin.source: broker instrument page; CUSIP P7924AAC2 in aviso de pago 12/05/2026

day_count.source: Suplemento 10/11/2025, Descripción de la Oferta, p. 112

frequency_months.source: Suplemento 10/11/2025, Fechas de Pago de Intereses

accrue_to_adjusted_date.source: Suplemento 10/11/2025, p. 112: no interest accrues after the due date

business_day_calendars.source: Suplemento 10/11/2025, definition of Día Hábil (Buenos Aires and New York)
